title: Low market beta
summary: Fit an intercept and market slope; beta = covariance(stock, market) / variance(market). Rank lowest beta first, including negative estimates.
universe: Indian cash equities · current Nifty 500-derived panel

rules.entry: Use the latest 252 simple daily returns for each stock and Nifty 500. Fit an intercept and market slope; beta = covariance(stock, market) / variance(market). Rank lowest beta first, including negative estimates. Choose up to 20 stocks and review quarterly; no momentum filter.
rules.exit: Sell when removed at a review. No stop-loss or take-profit. Estimate terminal liquidation at final close.
rules.sizing: Up to 20 stocks. Signal equity / 20 per new position; fractional shares; retained positions are not resized.
rules.execution: Rank on a completed session. Sell removals at the next tradable open; buy additions at signal + 3 sessions.

limitations: Complete history, positive volume and nonconstant stock returns. Unlevered low-beta long leg only, not the original beta-normalized long/short Betting Against Beta factor.
Current Nifty 500-derived universe, not historical constituents: survivorship and selection bias.
2018–2025 influenced parameter selection. The 2026 comparison has been inspected repeatedly; it is not an untouched holdout.
Fractional adjusted shares and normalized starting equity 100; no account-size, market-impact or whole-share constraint.
Current proportional delivery fees applied to all history; fixed DP fees, dividends, delisting proceeds and historical fee changes omitted.
Provider adjustments, retrospective exclusions and terminal-close estimates limit executable interpretation.
